## Validation

- [ ] Expected and applied patch IDs match
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`
- [ ] Workspace production checks
- [ ] Zero-warning clippy
- [ ] Workspace library tests
- [ ] Relevant integration or empirical tests
- [ ] Changelog updated
- [ ] Upstream record complete
- [ ] Independent diff review complete

## Isolation

- [ ] This pull request contains one upstream delta only
- [ ] Fork-owned behavior changes are excluded or follow separately
- [ ] Architecture pin/citation updates are excluded until after merge
- [ ] Failed, skipped, or blocked validation is stated explicitly
